class: H = {h_theta : theta in Z}; h_theta(x) = 1 iff x >= theta; x in Z
oracle: Exact membership labels from a fixed realizable target, accompanied by an externally authenticated record identity and revocation unit in one fixed authority/scope/verifier/epoch context
revocation: Any finite subset of declared revocation units; all records in a revoked unit become unavailable together
independence: Distinct revocation units can be revoked separately. This is neither statistical independence nor a claim that copied records have independent authority.
warrant: Agreement of all integer thresholds consistent with the surviving registered ledger; unregistered possible evidence is outside this snapshot
resources: stored authenticated record and revocation identities
theorems: exact surviving interval and complete per-query witnesses
adjacent boundary characterization of exact identification
optimal finite-interval worst-case repair query count ceil(log2 N)
unbounded interval has no uniform finite exact-query bound
finite identification of every integer target by exponential bracketing and binary search
strongest_parent: Exact threshold membership learning plus a complete provenance-indexed ordered multiset; parent sufficient under the identical interface
calibration: Exhaustive small integer intervals, ledger revocations and robustness witnesses, plus large integer and malformed-input controls. Finite tests calibrate code and do not prove the infinite theorem.
